title: Evaluation under input reindexing
statement: Let $m,k$ be natural numbers with $m=k$, let $T$ be a circuit tail with $m$ inputs, let $g$ be an AND or OR gate, and let $v:	ext{Fin}(k)	o	ext{Sign}$ assign a sign to each of the $k$ inputs. Evaluating $T$ after identifying its input indices with those of $k$ gives the same sign as evaluating $T$ on the values reindexed along that identification.
